items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Oh, they had, you see, Oyl Fushey, my nephew Sidney Brown, Andrew Morgan, Johnny Dave, Shine, Sam Morgan, Isaiah and myself.

ctx.x: Can you tell us a bit more about the Sam or the Isaiah Morgan band? Who else was in that band when you joined?

Oh, they had, you see, Oyl Fushey, my nephew Sidney Brown, Andrew Morgan, Johnny Dave, Shine, Sam Morgan, Isaiah and myself. And we just knew that woman, May, Piano, May. Sometimes we used Piano, you know, May, May, Piano.
Who else did you use on Piano later?

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Johnny Dave was on... banjo. Myself was on drum... Myself was on trombone.

ctx.x: ...but, uh... ...Oil Fushey on... ...on... ...on... ...on... ...Oil Fushey on, uh... ...on the alto sax. Andrew Morgan. He's on tenor. Bill Jim was on... ...bass. Johnny Dave was on... ...banjo. Myself was on drum... Myself was on drum... Myself was on trombone. And Roy was on, uh... ...Roy was on drums. Roy, Roy Evans.
How many times did you record?
